identity.title: Reduce first-time contributor burden in oversized WPF View code

origin.kind: explicit user request for continuous scheduled refactoring
origin.summary: The user requested sequential refactoring of Views that feel overloaded to a first-time contributor, without waiting for optional input, while preserving existing behavior and verification boundaries.

state.current_summary: PL-0021 resolved: M1 Pipeline Review layout owner, M2 Pipeline Review image/resource lifetime owner, M3 Shell Recipe Manager panel drag owner, and M4 final MVVM/partial/folder/call-path/build audit are verified for the source and focused-runtime scope. Debug and Release builds, focused WPF smoke, readiness, contracts, documentation index, refactor audit, and diff checks passed. Full WPF theme/DPI/monitor/input, camera/SDK/GPU, production hardware, and long-running native qualification remain explicitly unverified. No commit or push was performed.

objective.summary: Reduce the amount of unrelated UI lifecycle, mutable layout state, and resource ownership that a developer must read inside oversized WPF Views, using concrete existing responsibility owners or the smallest new concrete owner only where independent state and lifetime are demonstrated.
constraints: Work only in C:\Git\2D\Dev; keep C:\Git\2D\Original read-only.
Do not wait indefinitely for user input, hardware, camera, SDK, GPU, monitor, DPI, theme, or long-running native evidence; record those boundaries as unverified.
Preserve XAML names, binding contracts, public event contracts, explicit Preview/Run behavior, image ownership, cancellation, and shutdown semantics.
Do not add interfaces, managers, factories, providers, event buses, forwarding wrappers, or manual partial files without a demonstrated replacement or lifetime/test seam.
Do not reopen completed owners or mechanically split files by line count alone; each slice must move a real responsibility or record a no-change decision.
Use one bounded milestone per heartbeat and store generated evidence under D:\OpenVisionLab-TestData\OpenVisionLab_Dev\view-owner-refactor-20260912.
Do not commit, push, tag, release, deploy, or modify C:\Git\2D\Original from the scheduled work.

criteria.text: Every milestone records the current owner, intended owner, actual call path, mutable-state writer, lifetime/release owner, preserved XAML/public contract, and shortest reading route.
Each accepted source change moves a real responsibility or removes coupling from the View; file movement, region edits, and name-only wrappers do not count.
Each accepted source change passes the focused build and directly related contract/smoke/static checks, with runtime UI and hardware limits explicitly marked unverified when not executed.
The final milestone records the remaining oversized View boundaries, completed owner changes, verification evidence, and a first-contributor assessment without claiming unrun runtime coverage.

events.summary: M1 moved the independent Pipeline Review layout state and visual policy into OpenVisionPipelineReviewLayoutController. The View remains responsible for XAML event forwarding and unsubscribe lifetime; no additional abstraction or partial was added.

M2 proved a real resource lifetime boundary. A concrete image resource owner now clones/replaces/disposes the five View-held resources; no interface, manager, factory, partial, or duplicate rendering layer was added.

M3 proved an independent UI interaction boundary in the Shell View: panel drag has its own mutable state, pointer-capture lifetime, clamp policy, and existing test callback. A small concrete controller was added; Recipe workflow/navigation was intentionally left with existing owners.

All PL-0021 milestones have a recorded owner map and current verification evidence. The remaining Shell composition and known UI/path technical debt do not justify another mechanical View split without a new defect or independent boundary; close this bounded refactor and preserve the owner map for later work.

All PL-0021 required milestones and completion criteria are satisfied for the documented source/focused-runtime scope; pause the single heartbeat executor and retain unverified runtime rows as explicit boundaries.
